description: This Swift source file defines an enumeration 'StatusActivityBuilder' with a static method 'build' that constructs and returns a 'StatusPill.Activity' object based on various application states, including background status, gateway status, screen recording, camera HUD text, and voice wake status. It encapsulates logic for determining the current activity indicator to show in the UI, depending on the app's context.
